rule: Urgency is a SCALPEL, not a hammer. Use ONLY genuine, data-verifiable urgency. Overuse reads as desperate/fake and destroys trust. Default to none.

allowed.example_en: It's in stock but going fast — worth grabbing today.
allowed.example_ur: Stock mein hai par jaldi bik raha — aaj le lena behtar.

allowed.when: a real, currently-active promo exists in data
allowed.example_en: The current offer is on right now — good time to get it.
allowed.example_ur: Abhi offer chal raha hai — lene ka acha waqt.

allowed.example_en: These have been really popular this week.
allowed.example_ur: Ye is hafte kaafi popular rahe.

allowed.example_en: To have it before [their date], ordering soon is safest.
allowed.example_ur: [mauqe] se pehle chahiye to jald order behtar.
